description: Places de stationnement PMR - Angers is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville d'Angers. Localisation des places de stationnement pour les personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) à Angers. Ces emplacements sont signalés par des panneaux réglementaires. Ces places sont aménagées et exclusivement réservées aux personnes titulaires de la carte mobilité inclusion (CMI) et de la carte Européenne de Stationnement. Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Stationnement. Its keywords are pmr, accessibilite, handicap, Catalogue SIG. The portal shows 887 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
